personality_one_liner: A trustworthy, generous, and content-first marketplace where property photos shine and the layout feels naturally reassuring.

spacing.rule: Use generous iOS-native padding. Content should never feel cramped. Standardize card gaps at md (12) and screen edges at lg (16).

do's: Bottom tab bar (must have a >70% surface tint underneath so it remains readable)
Sticky bottom CTA bar on the Property Details screen (Book Now)
Sticky headers when scrolling long lists of properties
dont's: Do not use glass on property cards in the feed
Do not use glass on form inputs or standard buttons

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Introduce the value proposition and segment users into Tenant or Landlord roles.

states.loading: Centered spinner over the brand primary color.

screens.layout: Full-bleed image scenes using `expo-image`. A gradient scrim (bottom-heavy, black/surfaceInverse) MUST sit between the image and the text. The bottom 40% contains the title, subtitle, and two buttons: 'I want to rent' (primary) and 'I want to list' (secondary/brandSecondary).

screens.name: HomeFeed
screens.purpose: Allow tenants to discover available properties with high-quality visual cards.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for property cards (image block + 3 text lines).
states.empty: Illustration of an empty house/nest + 'No properties found in this area' + 'Clear Filters' button.

screens.layout: Screen root padding `lg`. Top header contains user greeting and a prominent Search Input (surfaceTertiary bg, no border). Below it, a horizontally scrolling row of filter chips (All, 1BHK, PG, etc.). Below chips, a vertical list of Property Cards. Cards are 100% width of the container. Card anatomy: 4:3 image on top, wrapped in a surfaceSecondary container with `lg` radius. Below image: Title (lg), Location (sm, textSecondary), Price (xl, bold). Bottom of card: small icon row (beds, baths).

screens.name: SearchFilters
screens.purpose: Detailed filtering for tenants to find specific property matches.
screens.layout: Often implemented as a full-screen modal or sheet. Vertical stack of sections: Location (input), Price Range (slider/inputs), Property Type (selectable chips), Bedrooms (rounded square toggle buttons). Bottom sticky CTA 'Show X Properties' sitting in a glassmorphic container to ensure reachability.

screens.name: PropertyDetail
screens.purpose: Showcase a single property comprehensively to convince the tenant to book.

states.loading: Skeleton loader matching the hero image and text blocks.
states.error: Icon + 'Property no longer available' + 'Go Back' button.

screens.layout: ScrollView. Top is a full-width horizontal image gallery (snap paging). Below the images, a content container with `lg` top radius that visually overlaps the image slightly. Content stack: Title, Location, Price (prominent), Divider, Amenities (grid of icon+text), Divider, Landlord Profile (Row: Avatar + Name + 'Verified' badge). A sticky bottom bar (glassmorphic, pinned above home indicator) holds the total monthly price on the left and a 'Book Now' primary button on the right.

screens.name: BookingFlow
screens.purpose: Capture tenant details and move-in dates to request a booking.

states.loading: Spinner on the CTA button while submitting.
states.error: Inline text errors below failed inputs.

screens.layout: Single column form. Labels above inputs. Inputs use `surfaceTertiary` background with no borders and `md` radius. Date picker for move-in date. Sticky primary CTA 'Confirm Booking' at the bottom inside a KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: LandlordDashboard
screens.purpose: Allow landlords to view their listed properties and incoming requests.

states.empty: Illustration + 'You haven\'t listed any properties yet' + 'Add Property' CTA.
states.error: Icon + 'Could not load your dashboard' + 'Retry' button.

screens.layout: Tabbed view or sectioned list: 'My Properties' and 'Booking Requests'. Booking requests shown as list rows (Avatar of tenant, Name, Dates, 'Accept' / 'Decline' buttons). FAB (Floating Action Button) positioned at bottom-right for 'Add Property', using brandPrimary color and glass effect.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality. Use generous padding, especially on the edges of the Home Feed (lg: 16pt) and between cards (md: 12pt).
Colors MUST stick to the defined Sage Green (brand: #5C715E) palette. NO BLUES, INDIGOS, OR PURPLES. The app should feel earthy, trustworthy, and calm.

Implement the Sticky Bottom CTA pattern on the Property Detail and Search Filter screens. The CTA must be anchored to the bottom using absolute positioning + safe area padding, placed over a glassmorphic or solid surface background to ensure it's always reachable without scrolling.

Property images MUST have a gradient scrim (top-to-bottom, transparent to surfaceInverse) if any white text or icons (like a favorite heart or status badge) are placed on top of them. The bottom stop of the scrim should be >= 70% opacity.
Typography weights are capped at 500 max. Do NOT use 600, 700, bold, or black. Create hierarchy using font size (sm to 2xl) and color (textPrimary vs textSecondary).
Forms should not have borders. Use 'surfaceTertiary' as the background for input fields, rounded at 'md'. Labels always sit above inputs.
Use Phosphor icons consistently. Ensure all icons on a given screen share the same weight/style (e.g., all outlined or all filled).
